Dating at an old restaurant.
Mar 2026 • Couples
After eating 77,49 times, I went on a date at a super old restaurant: CTY. It used to be very good here, now more office people down to eat so too crowded. The price is probably the size of L’usine, 180-250k/course.
I called cattle bread + 280k fried potatoes, my friend ate cows at 220k. The part of the fried beetle vs its rocket vegetables eat like the leaves of the beetle, quite solid: the fried potatoes charge their own money (55k), the portion of the cake is much, and the food is full. Cows shake soft, okay. But both of them are too expensive... I say that this price doesn’t seem to be worth it.

Hidden gem
Jan 2025 • Couples
This place is on the same block as the Hotel des Arts. It’s a bit hard to find because it’s at the back of a multi-storey retail/office building. You enter through the front door of the complex, walk to the back right and then through a black wooden door with the CTY logo on it. There is an inside restaurant area, and behind that an indoor/outdoor seating and dining area. You can choose which one you want to sit in. The style is very high end. We went two nights in a row and sat in the indoor/outdoor area. The menu is what I’d call modern Vietnamese fusion. For the main we had a prawn and mussel dish in a red chili sauce with corn and other vegetables. It came with lightly toasted crusty bread to dip in the sauce. Although that dish by itself was more than big enough for two people, we also had a range of five sharing plates to start, all of which were delicious. To top it off, they had a good range of wines, craft beers and Carlsberg and Kronenbourg 1664 on tap. We ate and drank a lot. Too much, but it was all so delicious. Although it wasn’t cheap by Saigon standards, it only cost us about AUD$100. We were very happy with that, because a similar meal with drinks in Australia would have cost about four times as much. If you weren’t lashing out, you could have a good meal with a couple of drinks for about AUD$40. Highly recommended.
